name: CalendarHeatmap
tagline: The Calendar Heatmap turns any list of records with a date into a calendar where every day is a coloured square.
description: The Calendar Heatmap turns any list of records with a date into a calendar where every day is a coloured square. The darker the square, the more happened that day - more site visits, more cases, more hours or more donations. It makes busy weeks, quiet periods, gaps and campaigns visible at a glance, and lets you click a day to see exactly which records are behind it.
features: Quarter and month views coloured by count
KPIs (total, active days, best day, streaks), goal markers
Day drill-down with record list and open
A phone month view with monthly bars
